inspection: Both finished PNGs viewed at original 1400x900 size; open construction image viewed at original size. Not a claim of user approval.
proportionsIdentity: Consistent weathered adult keeper: three-quarter face, beard, cap, long coat, leg separation. Face is angular cel geometry, not naturalistic drawing.
connectedFormsContacts: Near sleeve connects shoulder to adjusted elbow and wrist. Grip is placed at projected gate latch and the lever remains visible above and below fingers. Gate hinge straps/pins stay on the right post in both panels. Gate rotates 35 degrees, exposing the passage.
gestureExpression: Bent working arm in closed panel becomes extended in open panel. Neutral face changes to smile. Torso remains intentionally stable across this two-keyframe action.
inkFormShadows: Thicker outer coat and cap contours, narrower facial and fold lines, dark sleeve/side planes, tapered coat hatching, lighter lapels and pocket flaps.
perspectiveDepth: Paving, curbs, gate posts, bars, rail and hinges use one perspective camera. Receding pier and smaller lighthouse establish depth. Foreground keeper is separately authored 2D geometry.
speciesDesign: Human adult only; no creature-design claim.
storyTone: Rainy dawn harbor becomes safely accessible; calm work gesture and smile match the short neutral narration and dialogue.
limitations: Stylized vector/cel look rather than naturalistic ink mastery.
Only two poses and one camera; not continuous animation or varied cinematic coverage.
Author-authored 2D keeper is staged against projected 3D solids, not a complete 3D character rig.
